entries.name: box-valuse-unbound-sized-reject#0
entries.description: A bare box whose size-flagged v0 tree is 08 02 72 01: the body is ValUse(1) with no ValDef(1) in scope. The ValDef type store throws NoSuchElementException, not a ValidationException, so the size flag does not degrade it: the JVM rejects. An impl that degrades any body failure round-trips it: the over-accept.

entries.name: box-valuse-bound-sized-accept#1
entries.description: A bare box whose size-flagged tree binds it first: BlockValue(ValDef(1, SigmaProp(true)), ValUse(1)). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: box-valuse-unbound-unsized-reject#2
entries.description: A bare box whose unsized v0 tree is 00 72 01, the same unbound ValUse(1): rejected as well.
